decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-8b7267b73a1c] says Structured Metadata is enabled by default in Loki 3.0 and requires the active schema to use both the tsdb index type and the v13 storage schema. That defines exposure: environments upgrading to 3.0 without tsdb+v13 and without Structured Metadata disabled. [ev-649f409b4be1] and [ev-7791a108cc39] give the two ways out: set limits_config.allow_structured_metadata: false (or -validation.allow-structured-metadata=false), upgrade, then migrate the schema; or migrate the schema before upgrading. The consequence of doing nothing is only implied by "requires" (default 3.0 settings don't work with older schemas). The exact failure (startup or config error vs rejected writes) is not stated, hence low confidence.
